public_task_requirement: Please create a one-page website for promoting Fundraiser Day, including introduction to the event, fundraiser testimonials, offer information, and company information. The website should have functionalities such as an automatically moving carousel for displaying offers, a section for displaying fundraiser testimonials, and a section for displaying company information. Users should be able to browse the website to learn more about the Fundraiser Day event. Establish cornsilk as the main background and peru for the controls.

task_summary.requirement_coverage: The page was intended to be a one-page Fundraiser Day promotion site with an introduction, automatically moving offers carousel, fundraiser testimonials, and company information, using cornsilk as the main background and peru for controls. Verified strengths from the trajectory and code include visible top navigation, a Fundraiser Day intro on the home view, a testimonials section, a company info section, and the requested color styling on the main controls/background. Main functional risks were that the evaluation repeatedly could not confirm the intro content after scrolling, testimonials were reported as empty or not rendering in one check, company information was reported as absent in one check, and the offers carousel did not clearly demonstrate automatic movement in the observed interactions. Visible observations show a simple centered layout with Home/Testimonials/About Us buttons and a Next Offer control, with the home view presenting the event heading and a brief supporting sentence.
verified_strengths: Visible navigation entries for Home, Testimonials, and About Us are present on the landing page.
The home section includes a Fundraiser Day heading and introductory copy.
The design uses cornsilk as the page background and peru for the main controls.
A testimonials component and a company information component were implemented in the codebase.
An offers carousel component and a Next Offer control are present in the implementation.
primary_functional_risks: The intro content was not confirmed by the evaluator after repeated scrolling, so the event explanation may not have been reliably reachable in the tested state.
The testimonials section was judged empty in one functional check, indicating a rendering or population risk for supporter quotes.
The company information section was judged empty in one functional check, indicating a visibility or loading risk for organization details.
The offers carousel may not have been perceived as automatically moving during evaluation, so the required auto-advance behavior is uncertain.
The site appears to rely on section switching rather than a clearly continuous one-page browse experience, which may have affected content discoverability.
primary_visual_observations: The landing page shows a light cornsilk background with brown/peru-toned buttons.
The layout is minimal and centered, with a large heading and a small amount of body text visible on the home view.
The offers area appears visually sparse, with a single white content box and limited decorative treatment.
The overall first-screen composition is simple and uncluttered, with limited visual hierarchy beyond the main heading and navigation.

appearance_reflection.observed_result: The page uses a single centered heading, "Fundraiser Day - Join Our Community," and one short paragraph in the intro section. The reviewer described the text layout as overly simplistic, and the code shows no extra text styling beyond the default `h1` sizing in `src/style.css` and the centered layout in `src/App.vue`.
appearance_reflection.likely_cause_or_limitation: Appearance issue: the first screen reads as too plain because the text layout is minimally styled, not because the content is missing or broken.
appearance_reflection.preventative_action: Give the main text blocks clear typographic hierarchy with more than one level of emphasis, and verify that the first screen includes visibly differentiated heading and body text rather than a single plain text block.
appearance_reflection.verification: Render the homepage and check that the introduction has distinct heading and body styling, with the main message visually separated from the supporting paragraph.
appearance_reflection.transfer_limits: Applies to one-page promotional sites and other landing pages that rely on introductory copy as the main first-screen content.

investigation.task: The task was to verify the fundraiser testimonials section on the one-page Fundraiser Day site; the tester ended with ANSWER; NO and explicitly said the testimonials section looked empty, with only "What Our Supporters Say" visible and no participant feedback displayed.
investigation.reached_target: The tester did reach the testimonials view by clicking the "Testimonials" button, so the target feature was exercised rather than abandoned early.
investigation.screenshots: Both screenshots show the Testimonials tab active, the heading "What Our Supporters Say," and two large blank white cards where testimonial text should appear. No testimonial quotes, names, or roles are readable in either image.
investigation.code_path: src/App.vue conditionally mounts <Testimonials v-if="activeTab === 'testimonials'" /> from the navigation button; src/components/Testimonials.vue defines a testimonials array with two entries and renders them in a v-for inside .testimonial-card. The source therefore contains the content and the route to it, so the break is in how it is drawn on screen rather than in missing data or missing mounting.
investigation.style_trace: The testimonial text should be drawn inside .testimonial-card in src/components/Testimonials.vue, whose own styles set background-color: white and padding: 20px. Its parent .testimonials only sets padding, and the page shell in src/App.vue sets the section background to cornsilk. Global styles from src/style.css set :root text color to rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.87) and body/#app layout, but no rule hides the testimonial text. The deciding rule is the component's white card background combined with the inherited light text color, which makes the cards appear blank against the pale page background.
investigation.candidates: 1) Unreadable testimonial rendering: supported by the screenshots showing empty-looking white cards while the code contains testimonial content. 2) Missing feature: ruled out because src/components/Testimonials.vue exists and is mounted from App.vue. 3) Tester limitation: ruled out because the tester clicked into the testimonials view and scrolled, so the feature was exercised.
investigation.conclusion: The surviving cause is that the testimonials content is rendered in cards that are visually indistinct in the current styling, so the page does not present the testimonial text readably even though the data exists in the component.
